photos.title: Atlantic Ocean shoreline in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
photos.what: A crowded beach in Myrtle Beach on a sunny June day: rows of rental umbrellas and blue beach chairs on the left, oceanfront towers behind them, many small figures on the sand and in the surf. No person is the subject; the nearest people are small and their faces are not the point of the frame.
photos.caption: Myrtle Beach on a June day. Tourist season peaks in July, the month after houses here sell highest.
photos.alt: A crowded beach in Myrtle Beach in June, with rental umbrellas, rows of blue beach chairs and oceanfront towers
photos.author: Loadmaster (David R. Tribble)

The crop (x 0 to 1690, y 170 to 1121 of the 1920 x 1280 rendition, resized to 1200 x 675) leaves out the girl who sits large in the lower right corner of the original (the verifier's note) and the people nearest the camera on that side. What is left is the beach, the rental umbrellas and chairs, the towers and a crowd of small figures. The caption names the season the photo shows, not this year.
